description: Returns descriptive face-shape context, five subjective appearance scores, and an approximate Golden Ratio phi score for one authorized adult photo.

adult_and_authorized.description: Confirms the pictured person is an adult and the submission is lawful.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded JPEG, PNG, or WebP bytes, without a data URL prefix.

measurement_key.description: Optional. Return only one focused free-tool output instead of the full face report.

mime_type.description: Image media type. Supported formats are JPEG, PNG, and WebP.

name: score_face

error.description: Present when the tool call fails.

face_shape.description: Descriptive visible face-shape category and explanation.

model.description: Model version used for visible analysis.

overall_score_100.description: The same fixed weighted score from 0 to 100.

phi_score.description: Separate 0 to 100 Golden Ratio proportion context.

score_explanations.description: Photo-specific explanation for each named subscore.

scores.description: Five named appearance subscores from 0 to 10.

title: Score an authorized adult face
